note: Byte copies of conformance/tom/v2 and conformance/mind/v2 at this commit: the kernel contract 2.0 corpora of ADR-0030 (stage B, the typed supersession link). Contract 2.0 is a draft, so upstream may still change these bytes with no further bump, and nothing may be published as conforming to them. Each SHA256SUMS is upstream's own file; its digest is pinned here. The v1 corpora stay vendored beside them, frozen, with their own records (vendor/enaction/PROVENANCE.json for mind/v1, vendor/enaction/conformance/tom/PROVENANCE.json for tom/v1). Do not edit the vendored files: re-vendor from a new commit and update this record.
